smartphone_display.name: Display
smartphone_display.hint: Warm the edges with a hair dryer to soften the adhesive, then pry the display off with a plastic pick.

smartphone_back_cover.name: Back Cover
smartphone_back_cover.hint: Heat the edges to loosen the glue and lift the cover with a suction cup; wear gloves in case it cracks.

laptop_display.name: Display Panel
laptop_display.hint: Unscrew the hinges and disconnect the display cable before lifting the panel out.

tablet_display.name: Display
tablet_display.hint: Heat the edges and work around the frame with a plastic pick to release the adhesive.

smartwatch_display.name: Display
smartwatch_display.hint: Heat briefly and lift with a thin blade; the battery sits directly underneath.

lcd_panel.name: LCD Panel
lcd_panel.hint: Remove the back cover screws; handle the panel flat, it breaks easily.

lens_glass.name: Lens
lens_glass.hint: Unscrew the head of the flashlight to take the lens out.

aluminium_frame.name: Frame
aluminium_frame.hint: Remains after display, battery and board are removed.

aluminium_housing.name: Housing
aluminium_housing.hint: Remove all screws and internal parts first; the empty shell is pure aluminium.

aluminium_heat_sink.name: Heat Sink
aluminium_heat_sink.hint: Twist off the diffuser and pull out the LED module to free the heat sink.

li_ion_battery.name: Lithium-Ion Battery
li_ion_battery.hint: Never puncture or bend it; tape the contacts and bring it to a battery collection point.

alkaline_cell.name: Battery
alkaline_cell.hint: Remove from the device and tape the contacts before handing it in.

circuit_board.name: Circuit Board
circuit_board.hint: Unscrew and unplug all ribbon cables; hand in at an e-waste collection point.

sim_tray.name: SIM Tray
sim_tray.hint: Push a SIM tool into the small hole next to the tray.

electric_motor.name: Electric Motor
electric_motor.hint: Unscrew from the housing and cut the wires; contains copper windings and magnets.

speaker_driver.name: Speaker
speaker_driver.hint: Contains a strong magnet; keep away from cards and other electronics.

led_module.name: LED Module
led_module.hint: Pull it out of the socket or unscrew it from the reflector.

led_backlight.name: LED Backlight
led_backlight.hint: LED strips sit behind the diffuser sheets at the panel edges or back.

thermostat.name: Thermostat
thermostat.hint: Located under the base plate; unscrew the bottom cover to reach it.

copper_heat_pipe.name: Heat Pipe
copper_heat_pipe.hint: Unscrew the cooler assembly from the board and peel off the thermal pads.

cable_copper_core.name: Cable Wires
cable_copper_core.hint: Cut off the plug and strip the insulation to free the copper.

cable_insulation.name: Cable Insulation
cable_insulation.hint: Slit lengthwise with a cable stripper to separate it from the wires.

plug_pins.name: Plug Pins
plug_pins.hint: Brass pins are pressed into the housing; break the housing open to remove them.

connector_shell.name: Connector Shell
connector_shell.hint: Cut the cable just behind the connector.

plastic_housing.name: Plastic Housing
plastic_housing.hint: Look for hidden screws under rubber feet or labels, then pry the clips open.

keycaps.name: Keycaps
keycaps.hint: Pull straight up with a keycap puller or a bent paper clip.

steel_backplate.name: Metal Backplate
steel_backplate.hint: Remove after taking out the electronics; check with a magnet.

steel_stand.name: Stand
steel_stand.hint: Press the release button or unscrew the VESA screws.

rubber_scroll_wheel.name: Scroll Wheel
rubber_scroll_wheel.hint: Lift the wheel out of its axle once the housing is open.

silicone_keypad.name: Keypad
silicone_keypad.hint: Lifts out as a single mat once the housing is opened.

silicone_strap.name: Strap
silicone_strap.hint: Push the quick-release pin or button to detach the strap.

silicone_ear_tips.name: Ear Tips
silicone_ear_tips.hint: Pull them off the nozzle by hand.

ear_cushions.name: Ear Cushions
ear_cushions.hint: Twist or pull them off the ear cups; most are clipped in.

bulb_diffuser.name: Diffuser Dome
bulb_diffuser.hint: Twist or pry the dome off the base with a flat tool.

lamp_base.name: Screw Base
lamp_base.hint: Stays attached to the heat sink; hand in the bulb as e-waste if it won't separate.

brush_head.name: Brush Head
brush_head.hint: Pull it straight off the handle; dispose of separately from the handle.

heating_element.name: Heating Element
heating_element.hint: Unplug and let it cool down fully before opening the housing.

stainless_steel_body.name: Body
stainless_steel_body.hint: Remains after removing plastic parts, base and electronics.

plastic_handle.name: Handle
plastic_handle.hint: Usually held by one or two screws.

crumb_tray.name: Crumb Tray
crumb_tray.hint: Slide it out from the bottom of the toaster.

plastic_knobs.name: Knobs and Lever
plastic_knobs.hint: Pull them straight off the shafts.

aluminium_capsule.name: Capsule
aluminium_capsule.hint: Empty the coffee grounds into organic waste before recycling.

aluminium_lid_foil.name: Lid Foil
aluminium_lid_foil.hint: Peel it off completely and put it in the same bin as the cup.

aluminium_capsule_foil.name: Capsule Foil
aluminium_capsule_foil.hint: Cut along the ridge below the neck and pull the foil off.

aluminium_can_body.name: Can
aluminium_can_body.hint: Empty it; leave the tab attached.

aluminium_spray_can_body.name: Can
aluminium_spray_can_body.hint: Only recycle when completely empty; never pierce or crush a spray can.

aluminium_cup.name: Cup
aluminium_cup.hint: Let the wax cool and push it out from below.

pet_bottle_body.name: Bottle
pet_bottle_body.hint: Empty it and flatten lengthwise; return it if it carries a deposit logo.

hdpe_screw_cap.name: Screw Cap
hdpe_screw_cap.hint: Twist off; recycle it separately or keep it on as local rules require.

plastic_label.name: Label
plastic_label.hint: Tear along the seam or cut it off.

pp_flip_cap.name: Flip Cap
pp_flip_cap.hint: Unscrew it from the bottle or tube.

glass_container.name: Glass
glass_container.hint: Empty it and sort it by colour into the glass bin.

crown_cap.name: Crown Cap
crown_cap.hint: Use a bottle opener; it goes in the metal collection.

twist_off_lid.name: Lid
twist_off_lid.hint: Unscrew it and put it in the metal collection.

cork_stopper.name: Cork
cork_stopper.hint: Pull it out with a corkscrew; collect natural corks separately.

paper_label.name: Paper Label
paper_label.hint: Soak in warm water to peel it off; leaving it on is usually fine.

steel_can_body.name: Can
steel_can_body.hint: Rinse it; check with a magnet to tell it apart from aluminium.

steel_can_lid.name: Lid
steel_can_lid.hint: Push the sharp lid into the empty can before recycling.

carton_body.name: Carton
carton_body.hint: Empty and flatten it; do not separate the layers.

pp_cup_body.name: Cup
pp_cup_body.hint: Scrape it empty; there is no need to rinse it.

cardboard_sleeve.name: Cardboard Sleeve
cardboard_sleeve.hint: Tear along the perforation or slide it off.

coated_paper_cup.name: Cup
coated_paper_cup.hint: Has a plastic lining, so it does not go in paper recycling.

ps_cup_lid.name: Lid
ps_cup_lid.hint: Pull it off the cup rim.

cardboard_box_body.name: Box
cardboard_box_body.hint: Flatten it; tear off heavily greasy or food-soiled parts first.

packing_tape.name: Packing Tape
packing_tape.hint: Peel it off before flattening the box.

paper_sheets.name: Paper
paper_sheets.hint: Remove any plastic wrap or inserts.

ldpe_film.name: Film
ldpe_film.hint: Empty it and fold or ball it up loosely.

multilayer_film.name: Bag
multilayer_film.hint: Shake it empty; the metallised layer cannot be separated.

toothpaste_tube_body.name: Tube
toothpaste_tube_body.hint: Squeeze it empty; there is no need to rinse it.

spray_valve.name: Valve
spray_valve.hint: Crimped onto the can; do not try to remove it.

pen_barrel.name: Barrel
pen_barrel.hint: Unscrew the barrel to release the refill.

ink_refill.name: Ink Refill
ink_refill.hint: Replace the refill instead of the whole pen.

wooden_pencil_body.name: Wooden Body
wooden_pencil_body.hint: Lacquered wood; do not compost it.

rubber_eraser.name: Eraser
rubber_eraser.hint: Pinch the ferrule open with pliers to pull it out.

steel_blades.name: Blades
steel_blades.hint: Unscrew the pivot screw; wrap the blades before disposal.

plastic_handles.name: Handles
plastic_handles.hint: Often moulded on; cut them off if they won't come off.

steel_frame.name: Frame and Ribs
steel_frame.hint: Cut the fabric off at the rib tips.

polyester_canopy.name: Canopy
polyester_canopy.hint: Unpick the stitches at the rib tips and centre.

textile_upper.name: Upper
textile_upper.hint: Cut it away along the sole seam; donate wearable shoes instead.

foam_midsole.name: Midsole
foam_midsole.hint: Glued to the outsole; separate with a heat gun and a knife.

rubber_outsole.name: Outsole
rubber_outsole.hint: Peel it off the midsole after heating the glue.

cotton_fabric.name: Fabric
cotton_fabric.hint: Donate if wearable; otherwise use the textile collection.

care_label.name: Care Label
care_label.hint: Cut it off at the seam.

denim_fabric.name: Denim
denim_fabric.hint: Cut off rivets and buttons before textile recycling.

metal_rivets.name: Rivets and Buttons
metal_rivets.hint: Cut the fabric around each one.

metal_zipper.name: Zipper
metal_zipper.hint: Cut along both sides of the zipper tape.

plastic_buckles.name: Buckles
plastic_buckles.hint: Cut the straps just behind the buckle.

foam_padding.name: Padding
foam_padding.hint: Open the inner lining seam to pull it out.

plastic_frame.name: Frame
plastic_frame.hint: Unscrew the hinges to separate the temples.

tinted_lenses.name: Lenses
tinted_lenses.hint: Push them out of the frame from the inside.

hinge_screws.name: Hinge Screws
hinge_screws.hint: Unscrew them with a precision screwdriver.

tire_rubber.name: Tread
tire_rubber.hint: Take the tire to a bike shop or tire collection point.

steel_bead_wire.name: Bead Wire
steel_bead_wire.hint: Cut the rubber away along the rim edge.

tire_casing_fabric.name: Casing
tire_casing_fabric.hint: Vulcanised into the rubber; it cannot be separated by hand.

disc_body.name: Disc
disc_body.hint: Scratch it to make the data unreadable; some shops collect CDs.

cd_case.name: Jewel Case
cd_case.hint: Take out the booklet and the disc.

paper_booklet.name: Booklet
paper_booklet.hint: Slide it out from under the clips.

paraffin_wax.name: Wax
paraffin_wax.hint: Collect leftovers and melt them into new candles.

cotton_wick.name: Wick
cotton_wick.hint: Pull it out of the warm wax.

wick_holder.name: Wick Holder
wick_holder.hint: Small metal disc at the bottom of the wick.
